metadata.question: Does location (33.97811334086217, -118.2436826460509) at Los Angeles have a higher average nitrogen dioxide concentration than location (32.7358717958782,-117.15380986802357) San Diego from 2018 to 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-5P NO2-offline tropospheric column product. 2018-01-01 to 2019-12-31. 2. Masking: The S5P product is already screened for clouds/quality in the “qa_value” band; we will keep only qa_value > 0.75. 3. Logic: Compute spatial/temporal mean NO2 for each city point (buffer 5 km) over the 2-year window. – If either collection is empty → C1. – After masking if pixel count = 0 → C2. – If calculated mean is None/NaN → C3. – Otherwise compare means: LA > SD → A; else → B. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') la_pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.2436826460509, 33.97811334086217]) sd_pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-117.15380986802357, 32.7358717958782]) def no2_mean(pt, name): col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate('2018-01-01', '2019-12-31') .filterBounds(pt) .select(['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density','qa_value']) .map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('qa_value').gt(0.75)) .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'))) n = col.size().getInfo() print(f"{name} images: {n}") if n == 0: return None, 0 mean = (col.mean() .multiply(1e6) # mol/m² → µmol/m² .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=pt.buffer(5000), scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9)) val = mean.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo() cnt = (col.mean() .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=pt.buffer(5000), scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9) .get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo()) print(f"{name} NO2 (µmol/m²): {val:.3f}, pixels: {cnt}") return val, cnt la_no2, la_cnt = no2_mean(la_pt, "LA") sd_no2, sd_cnt = no2_mean(sd_pt, "SD") if la_no2 is None or sd_no2 is None: print("C1") elif la_cnt == 0 or sd_cnt == 0: print("C2") elif la_no2 > sd_no2: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

la_pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.2436826460509, 33.97811334086217])
sd_pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-117.15380986802357, 32.7358717958782])

def no2_mean(pt, name):
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2')
             .filterDate('2018-01-01', '2019-12-31')
             .filterBounds(pt)
             .select(['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density','qa_value'])
             .map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('qa_value').gt(0.75))
                                 .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density')))
    n = col.size().getInfo()
    print(f"{name} images: {n}")
    if n == 0:
        return None, 0
    mean = (col.mean()
              .multiply(1e6)          # mol/m² → µmol/m²
              .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                             geometry=pt.buffer(5000),
                             scale=1000,
                             maxPixels=1e9))
    val = mean.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
    cnt = (col.mean()
             .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                           geometry=pt.buffer(5000),
                           scale=1000,
                           maxPixels=1e9)
             .get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo())
    print(f"{name} NO2 (µmol/m²): {val:.3f}, pixels: {cnt}")
    return val, cnt

la_no2, la_cnt = no2_mean(la_pt, "LA")
sd_no2, sd_cnt = no2_mean(sd_pt, "SD")

if la_no2 is None or sd_no2 is None:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
elif la_cnt == 0 or sd_cnt == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif la_no2 > sd_no2:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
